note: Gate-checkable projection of the QA Checklist in ../../SKILL.md (authoritative). type=python checks are computable via genie_language.py; type=manual require native-speaker audit, render inspection, or live research.

GATE_1_configuration_and_per_unit.text: OV-LANG routing signals confirmed and recorded
Direction Declaration locked: SOURCE language+variant and TARGET language+variant (Phase 0 hard requirement, blocks all else)
Register Scope declared and recorded (formal only, informal only, or both)
Script and Typographic Profile declared; non-Latin font confirmed; RTL encoding plan confirmed if required
Pronunciation System Declaration recorded and confirmed appropriate by Domain Master
Children's Category research completed live; routes OV-KIDS if signals present
Title Clearance record exists with live sources and date; no conflict pending
Language Profile Card locked
Communicative promise or accurate count; letters/numerals/spaces only; two rendered lines or fewer
Byline fetched live from FNG; collision check passed; no credentials or invented biography; locked
Title Design Signature cleared catalog-distinctness gate
Unit plan drafted with per-unit fields; Applied Linguist reviewed
Domain Master (native speaker of TARGET) has read every target-language string in the unit
Zero machine-translation artifacts: any artifact is FAIL; unit returns to revision and re-audits
20-40 new vocabulary items per unit; all labeled for register; match declared regional variant
Dialogue is 8-16 speaker turns; register-labeled at head; Domain Master certified natural
Exactly one grammar point per unit; 3-5 example sentences; Applied Linguist + Domain Master confirmed
3-5 drills; every item one correct answer or all alternatives listed in key; no ambiguous items
Cultural note 100-150 words; factual, specific, sourced in ledger; Cultural Consultant confirmed; no stereotyping
Register labeling exhaustive and consistent; correct against declared Register Scope
Pronunciation transcription applied to all new items; declared system applied consistently
Compliance Sweep PASS: em dashes absent, en dashes absent, curly apostrophes only, no AI voice
Content Standards Check PASS (no pork, no alcohol, no associated scenarios or imagery)
Unit length on render 4-8 pages; correction via substantive content or scope only, never typography
Non-Latin script rendering verified visually on rasterized render if applicable
COMMUNICATIVE GOAL, vocabulary table, grammar section, drills, CULTURAL NOTE all present and correctly formatted

GATE_2_back_matter.text: ANSWER KEY complete: every drill item in every unit answered; grouped by unit and drill number; unambiguous
GLOSSARY covers every vocabulary item introduced across all units; alphabetical; register labels consistent; Domain Master verified
APPENDIX A conjugation tables for all verb classes/tenses introduced; sourced; Domain Master verified; no invented forms
APPENDIX B covers all phonemes in declared variant; IPA or declared system; source-language approximations accurate
APPENDIX C: every resource real and verifiable; no invented titles, authors, or institutions

GATE_3_contents_and_assembly.text: Two-pass Contents gate: printed folios equal actual for every entry; no 'undefined' strings
Live native page number field; front matter carries no visible folio; Introduction is page 1
TOC lists Introduction; every unit (H1) and its six elements (H2); ANSWER KEY; GLOSSARY; each Appendix by full title
Non-Latin script rendering re-verified on the full assembled artifact
No IMAGE PROMPT blocks in delivered file; table tags balance; marker string absent

GATE_4_final.text: Full gate register re-run on the complete artifact
Every foreground-background pair computes to at least 4.5:1
Byline appears in exactly two interior locations: title page and copyright attribution; no credentials
Suggested Resources (Appendix C): every citation confirmed real and verifiable
No invented statistics, claims, or attributions anywhere in manuscript or marketing
Operator Zero Correction Standard: delivered manuscript requires no manual formatting correction
